summary.en: Add a sync-first collaboration agreement for two coding agents sharing one folder and branch, and link it from the agent-development guide.
summary.zh: 新增「先同步、轮流作业」的双 Agent 协作约定（共享同一目录与分支），并在跨 Agent 开发指南中链接。

reason: Documentation-only change: it defines the working agreement for agents sharing this checkout and points to it from the existing cross-agent guide. No product, setup or advertised-capability behavior changes.

compatibility.en: No code, save, configuration or runtime behavior changes; no migration required.
compatibility.zh: 不改变代码、存档、配置或运行时行为，无需迁移。
